notes: All Executive Class passengers should be welcomed with Rose Buds.
All cooked meal packets should bear QR Code with details of Name of unit, FSSAI license no., Veg./Non-veg item name, Grammage etc. and date of packing and Veg/N.Veg. Sticker.
Pre-mix Tea/Coffee/Green Tea/Malt beverage should be served with Stirrer, paper napkin & Hot Water.
Only boneless chicken should be used in chicken dish preparation. Neck & wing portions of chicken should not be served.
The menu should be served on cyclic basis.
Service of Morning Tea/Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner to be done in acrylic trays (as per tray colour to differentiate Veg./N. Veg.).
Service Evening Snacks of local regional brands to be preferably done in Snacks Box with co-branding of Vande Bharat Train.
All the pakaging materials including disposable items may be as per colour scheme of Vande Bharat Express with co-branding of IRCTC and Licensee.
Extra Tea/Coffee Service to be provided on demand without extra charges.
All food items should be individually packed & served in Aluminium Casseroles and Parottas/Chappathis should be packed/served in aluminum wrapper.
Hard ribbed disposable paper cups to be used for service of Beverages.
